stem: Autosomal Dominant Tubulointerstitial Kidney Disease (ADTKD) caused by UMOD or MUC1 mutations typically presents in young adults with which clinical manifestations?

Progressive tubulointerstitial fibrosis, hyperuricemia/gout, and bland urinalysis without heavy proteinuria

stem: During human embryogenesis of the urogenital sinus under testosterone stimulation, the persistent Wolffian (mesonephric) duct gives rise to which adult male anatomical structures?

options.text: Vas deferens, epididymis, and seminal vesicles
